title: Playing Ball
description: Three short recordings about ball games: in the park, in a class and with a dog.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · In the park
parts.intro: You will hear Minh and Mai.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Let's play ball in the park, Mai.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: OK! Is it a football or a basketball?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: It's a football. It's yellow.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I like tennis best, but football is fun.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Run, Mai! Kick it to me!

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Oh no! I kicked it too far. It's in the tree.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Don't worry, Mai. I can climb the tree and get it.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Be careful, Minh! Please don't fall.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: I've got it! Now let's play again. It's a nice day.

parts.title: Part 2 · Ball class
parts.intro: You will hear a teacher, Miss Hoa.

script.speaker: Miss Hoa
script.text: Children, come here. We play ball today. Stand in a circle.

script.speaker: Miss Hoa
script.text: Throw the ball to your friend. Catch it with two hands. Don't kick it.

script.speaker: Miss Hoa
script.text: Now, Ben, you start.

script.speaker: Miss Hoa
script.text: Well done, everyone. You are very good at this game.

script.speaker: Miss Hoa
script.text: Now line up and walk back to the classroom. We have a story next.

parts.title: Part 3 · The dog and the ball
parts.intro: You will hear Tom and Lily.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Look! My dog has a ball.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: What's his name?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: His name is Max. He is brown.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Does he like water?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Yes, he jumps in the lake and gets the ball.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: He's great!

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I throw the ball far, and Max runs very fast. He is a good dog.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: I love him. Can I play with him next time, Tom?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Of course you can. He is a friendly dog.

questions.explanation: Minh says: "Let's play ball in the park."
Minh says the football is yellow.
Mai kicked it too far and it is in the tree.

questions.text: Does Mai think football is fun?
What do the children do first?
questions.explanation: Miss Hoa says: "Stand in a circle."

questions.text: How many hands do they use to catch?
questions.explanation: The teacher says to catch it with two hands.
Tom says his name is Max.

questions.text: Where does the dog get the ball?
questions.explanation: The dog jumps in the lake and gets the ball.
